### Import from a DBMS

```{r}
```{r import-sqlite-data}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)

db_path <- "C:\\Users\\steve\\Downloads\\food_composition.sqlite"
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), dbname = db_path)

dbWriteTable(con, "food_composition", data, overwrite = TRUE)

dbListTables(con)
dbListFields(con, "food_composition")

foods <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM food_composition LIMIT 20;")

dbDisconnect(con)
```
```
```{r}
```{r}
head(foods)
```
```
